pages.title: Ideas for Lisbon
pages.instruction: Listen for the problem, the response and the next step

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: Have you ever been to Lisbon? I’m looking for ideas
lines.audioText: Have you ever been to Lisbon? I’m looking for ideas.
lines.translation: Você já foi a Lisboa? Estou procurando ideias

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: Yes, I went last year. I took a tram and visited a castle
lines.audioText: Yes, I went last year. I took a tram and visited a castle.
lines.translation: Sim, fui no ano passado. Andei de bonde e visitei um castelo

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: The castle. The view was beautiful, but there were a lot of people
lines.audioText: The castle. The view was beautiful, but there were a lot of people.
lines.translation: Do castelo. A vista era linda, mas havia muita gente

questions.prompt: When did Ana go to Lisbon?

pages.instruction: Listen for the problem, the response and the next step

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: Have you ever visited the aquarium?
lines.audioText: Have you ever visited the aquarium?

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: No, I haven’t. I’d like to go next time
lines.audioText: No, I haven’t. I’d like to go next time.
lines.translation: Não. Gostaria de ir na próxima vez

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: Me too. I love watching the fish. We could go together
lines.audioText: Me too. I love watching the fish. We could go together.
lines.translation: Eu também. Adoro observar os peixes. Poderíamos ir juntas

lines.speaker: Ana

pages.title: Recommend something I’ll enjoy
pages.instruction: Ask about an experience, then choose a useful follow-up

pages.title: One experience, one plan
pages.instruction: Listen for the new information and decide how to respond
pages.message: Hi, Ana! A quick update from Lisbon. I’ve tried a pastel de nata now, and I loved it. I had one at a small café this morning. I haven’t visited the aquarium yet. I’m thinking of going tomorrow, but I haven’t booked a ticket. Have you ever been? I’d love to know what you thought of it before I decide
pages.audioText: Hi, Ana! A quick update from Lisbon. I’ve tried a pastel de nata now, and I loved it. I had one at a small café this morning. I haven’t visited the aquarium yet. I’m thinking of going tomorrow, but I haven’t booked a ticket. Have you ever been? I’d love to know what you thought of it before I decide.
pages.greeting: I have an update for you!

items.prompt: What has she tried, and what hasn’t she tried yet?

items.answer: She’s tried a pastel de nata, but she hasn’t visited the aquarium yet
